Already up, are we? Clouds look low today, like they mean to hold the light in. Used to be her own mother knew what that meant for the day's work.

No debts owed me, and none I owe—so far. The yard's waiting, and so's my stomach. Best get to work while there's light before any rain settles in. Holloway & Thorne's been steady, even when contracts were thin. Giselle's kept me on when she could've cut me loose. That counts for something.  Yard's busy already. Arjun and Idris talking, and Giselle's here—my employer, standing at the yard. Best let them know I'm present. Used to be her own father said a crew shows up before they're called for.
